To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
trainee teachers in Zimbabwe have limited knowledge of the communication needs of deaf learners and that they are reluctant to use sign language.

the education of deaf children is challenged in Zimbabwe by the lack of deaf assistants, by the lack of training for teachers of the deaf and the lack of a national curriculum that is appropriate for deaf children.

trainee teachers of deaf learners face challenges when teaching deaf learners, including communication barriers, lack of deaf assistants, and the lack of sign language as a medium of instruction in teacher training institutions, and that these challenges can be turned into opportunities for the improvement of teacher education for deaf learners.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the education of deaf children and the challenges and opportunities for their teacher educators.
the education of deaf children and the challenges and opportunities for teachers in Zimbabwe.
the communication challenges faced in teaching deaf learners by teacher trainees and the opportunities that these challenges present.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the education of deaf children is still a challenge in Zimbabwe, as it is in most parts of the world, because it has not been given the necessary attention.
there are opportunities in the use of sign language in the education of deaf children.
there is need for a comprehensive teacher education program that would equip trainee teachers with the knowledge and skills that they need to teach deaf learners effectively.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of sign language is a key issue in deaf education.
the trainees and their mentors are not prepared to work with deaf learners and that the training they receive is not adequate.
we have identified a number of challenges that are associated with the education of deaf children and the opportunities that these challenges present for teacher education.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the education of deaf children is a human rights issue and the education of deaf teachers is critical to ensuring that the right to education of deaf learners is upheld.

teacher education for teachers of deaf learners needs to be rethought in Zimbabwe, and that this is a task that can and should be undertaken collaboratively with deaf learners, deaf adults, and deaf adults who teach.
the education of deaf children can be improved if teacher trainees have the opportunity to work with a deaf assistant.
